scope: 28/32 nm pre-layout engineering envelope; not a foundry PDK

notes.vth: sigma is applied to |Vth|=0.4 V and independently sampled for selected-cell, reference and sense-amplifier mismatch hooks
notes.mobility: sampled as a positive global process multiplier and applied to every MOS instance through the BSIM4 MULU0 instance parameter
notes.capacitance: implemented as a positive lognormal PAR_SCALE about one
notes.dynamic_noise: redrawn per read and represented as an equivalent differential SA input perturbation
notes.areas_and_collection: layout/TCAD-free RPP assumptions; these dominate absolute cross-section uncertainty and must be replaced after layout or beam calibration
notes.tid: the three 14.32 krad corners reuse TID_28nm_parameter_envelope.json; central is a published-geometry extrapolation and the other two are engineering bounds
